text: How old were you when you found out
that if you put pumpkin puree, almond flour,
oat flour, almond butter, two teaspoons of honey,
pumpkin pie spice, all together.
Mix really well, roll them into balls,
and dust them with monk fruit sugar.
Keep them in the fridge or freezer
for a wholesome, guilt-free treat whenever you need one.
You end up with a soft, no-bake bite
that tastes like pumpkin pie,
but is actually working for you.
The almond flour and almond butter keep it low glycemic,
so it won't spike your blood sugar.
The oat flour keeps you full,
and the monk fruit sugar means you get that sweet coating
without the blood sugar spike of regular sugar.
Plus, the healthy fats feed your brain
and slow down digestion,
giving you clean, steady energy for hours
without the afternoon crash.
I have recipes like this for every snack you can think of.
No refined sugar, low carb, real ingredients,
and they taste amazing.
Comment yes if you want more like this, my friend,
and follow me so you do not miss a single one.
Take care of yourself.
